name: @w6w-apps/harvest
description: Track time entries, projects, tasks, clients, and users via the Harvest API v2.

w6w.longDescription:
Harvest tracks time entries, projects, tasks, clients and users through Harvest's own API v2, giving a workflow the same time-tracking primitives as the product itself. Time entries can be created, read, updated and deleted, and Harvest's own timer controls are used directly to start, stop and restart a running entry rather than approximating them with plain create calls.

Every request carries both a token and an explicit account id, since a single Harvest credential can reach more than one account — connecting confirms the id actually resolves to a real Harvest account before it's used anywhere else. Both a personal access token and OAuth2 are supported, covering unattended automation and interactive sign-in alike.

Billing and CRM-adjacent surfaces — invoices, estimates, expenses, contacts and companies — are left out of this first pass; the actions here stay focused on the time-tracking data the API's own name promises.
